OPTIMAL_TAPS_IS_CONSTANT.why: one offer means one path: offer -> staff -> day -> slot -> identity -> submit. Taps-to-goal has no variance across tasks for an arm that navigates correctly, so it cannot separate two correct arms on this venue. Registered before the run: hit@N and seconds-to-goal carry the signal here; taps-to-goal becomes a discriminating measure only on a second venue with more than one offer.

what_varies: only DEPTH — which of 3 staff, how far down the open-day strip, and how far into the day's 18 slots. Those are recorded per task because they are the only thing a predicted head could exploit.
